hooks.command: for p in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/repo_guard.py"; done; for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(len(sys.argv) != 2)' x >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/repo_guard.py"; done; exit 0

for p in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/skill_routing_context.py" session; done; for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(len(sys.argv) != 2)' x >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/skill_routing_context.py" session; done; exit 0

for p in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/skill_routing_context.py" prompt; done; for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(len(sys.argv) != 2)' x >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/skill_routing_context.py" prompt; done; exit 0
